message.content:
**Interpretation 1 – “\(2\) 的 \(5\) 次方再开 \(5\) 次方”**  
If you mean \((2^{5})^{5}\), then

\[
(2^{5})^{5}=32^{5}=33\,554\,432 .
\]

**Interpretation 2 – “\(2\) 的 \(5\) 次方的次方”**  
If you mean \(2^{(5^{5})}\), then

\[
2^{5^{5}}=2^{3125}.
\]

This number has  

\[
\log_{10}(2^{3125})=3125\log_{10}2\approx 941.04
\]

decimal digits, so it is roughly

\[
2^{3125}\approx 1.09\times10^{941}.
\]

---

So depending on whether you intended \((2^{5})^{5}\) or \(2^{5^{5}}\), the result is either **33 554 432** or an astronomically large number **≈ 1.09 × 10⁹⁴¹**.
